select TransactionTypeId TransactionTypeId2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT TransactionTypeId TransactionTypeId2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_TRANCODE WHERE TransactionTypeId='3115'
UNION ALL
SELECT TransactionTypeId TransactionTypeId2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_TRANCODE WHERE TransactionTypeId='3116'
UNION ALL
SELECT TransactionTypeId TransactionTypeId2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_TRANCODE WHERE TransactionTypeId='3117'
UNION ALL
SELECT TransactionTypeId TransactionTypeId2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_TRANCODE WHERE TransactionTypeId='999999' ) temp order by TransactionTypeId, SCD_START_DATE
